trigger.failure: Pair-filtered response for frozen pair 63235 x 4242 contained observations with other NORAD identifiers while station 4242 matched.

root_cause.live_filter_behavior: filter_by_norad_cat_id resolves the current NORAD identifier to SatNOGS satellite IDs and filters Observation.sat_id by the resolved ID set.
root_cause.serializer_behavior: norad_cat_id is computed from the observation sat_id through the live satellite cache.
root_cause.documentation_mismatch: The generated OpenAPI client documentation still advertises satellite__norad_cat_id even though the release 1.134 ObservationFilter exposes norad_cat_id.

scientific_effect.qualification_interpretation: The prior qualification queries established station activity but did not establish >=20 observations for each satellite-station pair.

disposition.required_correction: Re-run deterministic seed discovery and pair qualification using live release 1.134 parameter norad_cat_id plus ground_station, retaining all other prospectively frozen selection rules and hard request cap.
